milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the barrel (3 blocks south of spawn) and face it to confirm visual identification. The barrel is the first landmark in the scene, placed at spawn-relative [0, 0, 3].

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must walk along the cobblestone path to reach and look at the jungle slab platform at spawn-relative [0, 0, 10]. The platform spans x=-2 to +2, z=10-11, so the center target [0, 0, 10] with max_distance=5 covers approaching from any direction.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must locate the magenta stained glass pillar (3 blocks tall at x=-8, z=10, player's right when facing south). Target y=1 is the middle of the pillar (eye level). max_distance=8 allows detection from the jungle slab platform area while still requiring meaningful approach.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must locate the cyan stained glass pillar (3 blocks tall at x=+8, z=10, player's left when facing south). Target y=1 is the middle of the pillar (eye level). max_distance=8 allows detection from the jungle slab platform area while still requiring meaningful approach.
